note: Financials in USD millions. Stock price listed in CAD (TSX). DCF performed in USD. Intrinsic values in USD; divide by 0.70 for CAD equivalent.

historical_growth.growth_rate_notes: Equity CAGR excluded as primary metric because CSI uses significant leverage for acquisitions without buybacks, distorting book value growth. FCFA2S (Free Cash Flow Available to Shareholders) is management's preferred intrinsic value metric and is used as the primary growth driver. FCFA2S 5yr CAGR of 20.1% is within 5pp of Revenue 5yr CAGR (23.6%) and EPS 5yr CAGR (17.0%) - no divergence flag needed.

base.notes: Decelerating from recent 20%+ FCFA2S growth toward 12% as deployment scale increases. WACC 10% reflects Canadian software conglomerate with moderate leverage and established track record.

bull.notes: Bull case assumes sustained high acquisition pace, improving organic growth (5%+), successful large VMS pursuit, and Topicus/Lumine continuing strong European expansion. Lower WACC reflects premium business quality.

bear.notes: Bear case assumes leadership transition disruption, PE competition severely compressing acquisition IRRs, Altera remaining a drag, and FCFA2S growth decelerating sharply. Higher WACC reflects elevated execution risk.

base.note: Entry price to achieve 15% CAGR from today to terminal value per share in year 5

sensitivity.description: Intrinsic value per share in USD using base case growth rates

csu_specific_notes.fcf_metric: FCF used is FCFA2S (Free Cash Flow Available to Shareholders), CSU's proprietary metric that deducts acquisition-related maintenance CapEx and preferred dividends from operating cash flow. This is more conservative than simple OCF minus CapEx.
csu_specific_notes.share_count_static: CSU does not repurchase shares. Share count has been stable at 21.192 million since at least 2015. No dilution expected.
csu_specific_notes.equity_cagr_excluded: Equity/Book Value CAGR (36.8% 5yr) excluded as primary metric because CSI uses acquisition leverage that inflates book value growth without corresponding per-share benefit. FCFA2S CAGR is used instead.
csu_specific_notes.currency: DCF performed entirely in USD. Current price shown in CAD (TSX-listed). CAD equivalent intrinsic values use 0.70 USD/CAD rate.
csu_specific_notes.irga_liability: The IRGA liability (Topicus Joday Group put option, ~$1.03B at Q3 2025) is not included in net debt calculation but represents a contingent financial obligation. Investors should be aware of this off-balance-sheet risk.
csu_specific_notes.dividend: CSU pays a quarterly dividend of $1.00/share ($4.00/yr USD). This is modest relative to FCFA2S and not separately modeled.
